Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: LoadPackages
#| echo: false

library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
BiocManager::install("limma")
library(limma)

```

Load the Data

```{r}

#| label: AccessData
#| echo: False

options(timeout = 600)

#Retrieves the MicroArray Device information data from NCBI GEO 
GPL11012 <- getGEO("GPL11012")

#Extracts tabular data (microarray annotation table)
annotation <- Table(GPL11012)
dim(annotation)

#Download the supplementary raw microarray data files to process (tar file)
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE24nnn/GSE24504/suppl/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  destfile = "../_raw/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  mode = "wb"
)

untar(
  tarfile = "../_raw/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  exdir = "../_raw/GSE24504"
)

```



```{r}

# Retrieve the paths of the microarray files
rawFiles <- list.files(
  path = "../_raw/GSE24504",
  pattern = "\\.txt\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(rawFiles)
head(rawFiles)

View(len)
```
```{r}
#| label: inspect_single_array

#Read and inspect the microarray file structure
rawArray <- read_tsv(
  rawFiles[1],
  skip = 1
)

dim(rawArray)
head(rawArray)
colnames(rawArray)

#We identify the columns that we are interested (intensity and backrgound intensity 
#and test it on the 1st one.
testArray <- rawArray |>
  select(
    Spot = 1,
    G = 2,
    Gb = 5,
    R = 12,
    Rb = 17
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Spot = str_squish(Spot)
  )
head(testArray)


#See if all files have identical column structures...

allHeaders <- rawFiles |>
  map(function(file) {
    #Read the first two lines from each file
    headers <- read_lines(file, n_max = 2)

    tibble(
      Channel = str_extract(str_split(headers[1], "\t")[[1]], "Green$|Red$"), #We only extract if green or red columns
      Parameter = str_split(headers[2], "\t")[[1]]  #Here you extract the parameter names of each column  
    )
  })

allHeaders |>   #Then you simply compare the 1st element in the list of tibbles with all the other tibbles.
  map_lgl(~ identical(.x, allHeaders[[1]])) |>
  table()

#Return TRUE if all headers are identical
```

```{r}
#| label: define-array-reader

#Read each array file and extract the important columns to us
readArray <- function(file) {

  read_tsv(
    file,
    skip = 1
  ) |>
    select(
      Spot = 1,
      G = 2,
      Gb = 5,
      R = 12,
      Rb = 17
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Spot = str_squish(Spot)
    )
}
#Test function on 1 file
testArray <- readArray(rawFiles[1])
head(testArray)
dim(testArray)

#Apply the function on all files and obtain a list of tibbles
arrayList <- rawFiles |>
  map(readArray)
length(arrayList)


```

```{r}

#| label: extract-sample-identifiers

#Obatain the sample IDs
sampleIDs <- rawFiles |>
  basename() |>#Rmvs all the path untile filename
  str_extract("GSM[0-9]+")

#Verify there are no duplicates
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(sampleIDs),
  !anyDuplicated(sampleIDs)
)

#Identify all of your tibbles with a name
arrayList <- arrayList |>
  set_names(sampleIDs)
head(names(arrayList))
```

```{r}
#Verify that there are no spots repeated so that you can combine the tables
spotLabels <- arrayList[[1]] |>
  pull(Spot)

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(spotLabels),
  !anyNA(spotLabels)
)
#Also check if they are in the same order or not
sameOrder <- arrayList |>
  map_lgl(
    ~ identical(.x$Spot, spotLabels)
  )

table(sameOrder)
```



```{r}

#| label: create-intensity-matrices

#Make everything for limma to process
G_matrix <- do.call(cbind, map(arrayList, "G"))
Gb_matrix <- do.call(cbind, map(arrayList, "Gb"))
R_matrix <- do.call(cbind, map(arrayList, "R"))
Rb_matrix <- do.call(cbind, map(arrayList, "Rb"))
dim(G_matrix)


#There were some problems with using the package directly to do this... the the 
#matrix was construted manually... 

RG <- new(
  "RGList",
  list(
    R = R_matrix,
    G = G_matrix,
    Rb = Rb_matrix,
    Gb = Gb_matrix,

    genes = data.frame(
      Spot = spotLabels
    ),

    targets = data.frame(
      FileName = basename(rawFiles),
      SampleID = sampleIDs
    )
  )
)

rownames(RG) <- spotLabels
colnames(RG) <- sampleIDs

class(RG)
dim(RG)

```



```{r}

#| label: inspect-annotation

annotation <- annotation |>
  as_tibble()

#See the annotation table
glimpse(annotation)
colnames(annotation)
head(annotation)
stopifnot(all(spotLabels %in% annotation$SPOT_LABELS))

#Standarize the annotation table with the right spotLabels title and stuff
spotTable <- tibble(Spot = spotLabels)
annotationPrepared <- spotTable |>
  left_join(annotation, by = c("Spot" = "SPOT_LABELS"))

#Put the gene annotation into the data object
RG$genes <- as.data.frame(annotationPrepared)


```



```{r}
GSE24504 <- getGEO("GSE24504")

#Here we have the metadata to match our data using the GeoAccession and know which 
#sample is that column from...
metadata <- pData(GSE24504[[1]]) |>
  as_tibble()

glimpse(metadata)
colnames(metadata)


#Don't have duplicates and also check if sample IDs used to create the microarray data object
#are all in the metadata
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(metadata$geo_accession),
  all(sampleIDs %in% metadata$geo_accession)
)

#Construct table to align the metadata
metadataAligned <- tibble(
  SampleID = sampleIDs,
  FileName = basename(rawFiles)
)
#Join everything into a single ordered table 
metadataAligned <- metadataAligned |>
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = c("SampleID" = "geo_accession")
  )

#Now we have exactly in the same order the metadata and the RG array data
stopifnot(
  identical(
    metadataAligned$SampleID,
    colnames(RG)
  )
)

#Improve you metadata labels
metadataAligned <- metadataAligned |>
  select(
    SampleID,
    FileName,
    Tissue = `tissue:ch1`,
    FastingHours = `timepoint:ch1`,
    Mouse = `mouse:ch1`,
    Strain = `strain:ch1`
  ) |>
  mutate(
    FastingHours = as.integer(FastingHours),
    Mouse = as.integer(Mouse)
  )

head(metadataAligned)

#Get you experimental design
metadataAligned |>
  count(Tissue, FastingHours) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = FastingHours,
    values_from = n
  )

#Store metadata in array object
RG$targets <- as.data.frame(metadataAligned)

colnames(RG) <- metadataAligned$SampleID
```

```{r}
#| label: background-correction

#Correct for the background noice using normexp (authors did the same)
RG_corrected <- RG |>
  backgroundCorrect(
    method = "normexp",
    offset = 0
  )

sum(RG_corrected$G <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(RG_corrected$R <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(as.vector(RG_corrected$G))

summary(as.vector(RG_corrected$R))
```

Normalization:

```{r}

#| label: extract-grid-layout

#The authors performed a "print-tip LOESS normalization" which is a normalization
#To determine how the print tip and location affected the measure so it is a 
#physical normalization procedure...

#Extract the location using regular expressions
probeLayout <- RG_corrected$genes |>
  as_tibble() |>
  extract(
    Spot,
    into = c("GridRow", "GridCol", "SpotNumber"),
    regex = "R(\\d+)\\s*-\\s*C(\\d+)\\s*:\\s*(\\d+)",
    remove = FALSE,
    convert = TRUE
  )

head(probeLayout)

#Obtain the order of the spots because we need to give them to limma in a certain order
spotOrder <- probeLayout |>
  mutate(OriginalRow = row_number()) |>
  arrange(GridRow, GridCol, SpotNumber) |>
  pull(OriginalRow)

#This simultaneously reorders the fluorescence matrices and the gene annotation.
#We do it directly on the object
RG_corrected <- RG_corrected[spotOrder, ]

#Internal dimensions of 21 × 45, 2 columns, 12 rows
printLayout <- list(
  ngrid.r = 12,
  ngrid.c = 2,
  nspot.r = 21,
  nspot.c = 45
)

#Authors  excluded control probes from the normalization so we assign weights

normalizationWeights <- if_else(
  RG_corrected$genes$FLAG == 0,
  1,
  0
)
normalizationWeights[1:20]



MA_before <- RG_corrected |>
  normalizeWithinArrays(
    method = "none",
    bc.method = "none"
  )


tibble(
  M = MA_before$M[, 1],
  A = MA_before$A[, 1]
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = A, y = M)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Before normalization") +
  theme_minimal()




MA <- RG_corrected |>
  normalizeWithinArrays(
    layout = printLayout,
    method = "printtiploess",
    weights = normalizationWeights,
    bc.method = "none"
  )

MAplotData <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    M = MA_before$M[, 1],
    A = MA_before$A[, 1],
    Processing = "Before"
  ),
  tibble(
    M = MA$M[, 1],
    A = MA$A[, 1],
    Processing = "After"
  )
)

MAplotData |>
  mutate(
    Processing = factor(
      Processing,
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    ),
    FLAG = rep(MA$genes$FLAG, 2)
  ) |>
  filter(FLAG == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = A, y = M)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    color = "blue",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Processing) +
  theme_minimal()

class(MA)

names(MA)

dim(MA$M)


```


```{r}

#OBTAIN THE EXPRESSION MATRIX

expressionMatrix <- -MA$M

rownames(expressionMatrix) <- MA$genes$ID

expressionMatrix <- expressionMatrix |>
  data.frame() |> 
  arrange(as.numeric(rownames(expressionMatrix))) |> 
  as.matrix()

dim(expressionMatrix) 

expressionMatrix[1:5, 1:5]
```

```{r}
#COMPRARE TO THEIR RESULTS


publishedExpression <- exprs(GSE24504[[1]])


stopifnot(
  all(rownames(expressionMatrix) %in%
        rownames(publishedExpression)),

  all(colnames(expressionMatrix) %in%
        colnames(publishedExpression))
)

validation <- tibble(
  SampleID = colnames(expressionMatrix),

  Correlation = map_dbl(
    seq_len(ncol(expressionMatrix)),
    ~ cor(
      expressionMatrix[, .x],
      publishedExpression[, .x],
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )
)

summary(validation$Correlation)

validation |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Correlation)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  theme_minimal()

tibble(
  Ours = expressionMatrix[, 1],
  Published = publishedExpression[, 1]
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Published, y = Ours)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
